name: Eaglerium (Lithium Math Port)
description: Port of Lithium-style algorithms: Fast trigonometry tables, vector memory caching, and physics optimization.
author: EAG Forge Revamped Team

name: EAGOpt (Frame Pacer & Redundancy Filter)
description: Partners with Eaglerium. Smooths frame pacing, eliminates duplicate WebGL texture flips, and reduces background lag.
author: EAG Forge Revamped Team

name: EAGZoom (OptiFine Camera Zoom)
description: Press and hold 'C' in-game for a smooth cinematic camera zoom.
author: EAG Forge Revamped Team

name: Fullbright (Night Vision Gamma)
description: Press 'B' in-game to toggle full lighting brightness in dark caves and nighttime.
author: EAG Forge Revamped Team

name: WorkServers (Unblocked Live Hub)
description: Pre-populates the multiplayer list with active, unblocked servers and WebSocket proxies.
author: EAG Forge Revamped Team
